text:
O St. Joseph, whose protection is so great, so strong, so prompt before the throne of God,
I place in you all my interests and desires.
O St. Joseph, do assist me by your powerful intercession
and obtain for me from your divine Son
all spiritual blessings through Jesus Christ, our Lord;
so that having engaged here below your heavenly power,
I may offer my thanksgiving and homage to the most loving of fathers.
O St. Joseph, I never weary of contemplating you and Jesus asleep in your arms;
I dare not approach while He reposes near your heart.
Press Him in my name and kiss His fine head for me,
and ask Him to return the kiss when I draw my dying breath.
St. Joseph, patron of departing souls, pray for us.
Amen.
latin: O Sancte Ioseph, cuius protectio tam magna, tam fortis, tam prompta est ante thronum Dei, commendo tibi omnia mea studia atque desideria. O Sancte Ioseph, adiuva me tua potenti intercessione, et impetra mihi a divino Filio tuo omnes benedictiones spirituales per Iesum Christum Dominum nostrum, ut cum caelesti virtute tua hic in terris usus fuerim, gratiarum actionem et obsequium offerre possim amantissimo Patri. O Sancte Ioseph, nunquam fatigor te contemplari et Iesum dormientem in brachiis tuis; non audeo accedere dum Ipse requiescit iuxta cor tuum. Preme Eum meo nomine et osculare pulchrum caput eius pro me, et roga Eum ut osculum reddat cum spiritum efflavero. Sancte Ioseph, patrōne morientium, ora pro nobis. Amen.
